Jethalal gets a shock when his client Manoj calls to say he can't transfer expected funds because his wife left for her maternal home with the chequebook. This leaves Jethalal ₹8 lakh short of the ₹25 lakh cheque Champaklal has pledged to donate the next morning for a village girls' school (kanyashala)
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
